priorityList: Use Outbreak when not running Blightburst
Use Army + Dark Transformation + Trinket + Combat Potion
Use Outbreak to maintain your plagues on the target
Use Soul Reaper if the enemy is below 35% health or you have triggered the Reaping effect from Dark Transformation
Use Death Coil when you have a Sudden Doom proc or 80+ Runic Power
Prioritize cooldown setup and execution to maximize damage
Spend Sudden Doom procs with Death Coil or Epidemic as quickly as possible
